body:
This is the worst addiction ever. If I went a few hours without having a smoke, I would get angry and now that I look back, probebly got on everyones nerves. I experiment with many drugs, but no drug has ever had and such an addictive effect on me. At some points, I would beg people for a smoke or even just a drag, just enough to get my fix and look fucking pathetic.
I am currently in the process of quitting, and this is the hardest thing I have ever had to do. I had to promise people I was going to quit, so I actually would and not spend the rest of my life in that process.
Waste of time, money and energy...but so, so good.
